## Marker

What gives the AI away: a construction, a word, a rhythm pattern. Italian-specific
markers (calques from English, missing intercalari/clitics, falsi amici) are
especially welcome.

## False-positive check

Where does the same pattern appear in real Italian writing? Why is it still a
marker and not normal Italian? The tighter the rule, the better. Native-speaker
judgment is gold here.
